d: Distribution: Although the species has been reported broadly from “ S. India ” and “ Travancore ”, the species is not at all widespread. Only four confirmed locations are known (Fig. 6): Thenmala (type locality) and Kattilappara (both in Shendurney WLS), Palode (Nedumangad Taluk, Thiruvananthapuram District) and Kottayam (Kottayam District, the Sharman location; see Materials and Methods). All four locations are in Kerala. This narrows the distributional range to southern Travancore, although the species may likely be found in other low-lying evergreen forest patches of Travancore in southern Kerala. In any case, the species appears to be endemic to Kerala.
